FEATURES

Everything between the swipe and the ledger.
01
Auto-categorisation

Every transaction is sorted the moment it lands, using the coding your team already trusts. Corrections are remembered, so the next close starts cleaner.

02
Duplicate detection

Repeated charges are caught before they reach your ledger, matched on merchant, amount and date. Your team reviews a short list instead of chasing down statements.

03
Month-end close

Every account, card and category arrives in one reconciled view. Sign-off takes hours, with a clear audit trail behind every decision.

HOW IT WORKS

Three steps. One clean ledger.
01
Connect your cards

Link the cards your team already uses. Ledgerly begins sorting spend from the first transaction.

02
Review flagged spend

Work through a short queue of anything that needs a decision. Approve or correct it, then move on.

03
Export to your ledger

Send a clean, coded file to the accounting system you already use. No re-keying.
